Ethscriptions.com’s main marketplace contract on Ethereum Mainnet was exploited in July 2023. Attackers withdrew Ethscriptions from listings they did not own, resulting in the theft of approximately 202 Ethscriptions from at least 123 addresses. Catalogue loss is estimated at ~$2,828, but the true market value remains uncertain. Marketplace contract processed withdrawals based on local ownership assumptions without verifying real Ethscriptions protocol ownership, enabling unauthorized access by attackers.
